summary: Dedicated General Practice Physician with a completed General Residency at São João University Hospital and full professional autonomy (Ordem dos Médicos License No. 68421). Proven expertise in outpatient primary consultations, adult emergency triage, and multidisciplinary clinical care supported by native Portuguese, professional English, and proficiency in SClínico and SAM electronic health records.

experience.title: General Practice Medical Resident
bullets: Conducted comprehensive clinical rotations across Adult Emergency Care, Internal Medicine Ward, Primary Healthcare Center, General Surgery, and Pediatrics.
Performed primary clinical triage, medical history taking, physical examinations, and basic emergency interventions.
Utilized SClínico and SAM electronic health record systems to maintain accurate patient documentation and collaborated effectively within an interdisciplinary medical team.
